title: Pod chats in the bucket, new tree: your "Per-database epoch" pick collides with your Nov 2 order on incarnations. Which shape?
body:
picked “One path per chat, no folders”
Board question: Pod chats in the bucket, new tree: your "Per-database epoch" pick collides with your Nov 2 order on incarnations. Which shape?
Card said: Pod chats in the bucket, new tree: a reviewer found that your "Per-database epoch" pick conflicts with your Nov 2 order to remove the incarnation machinery and keep it out of browsers and Macs. That reading of the Nov 2 order is the reviewer's, not your words. - **The conflict:** with per-database epochs, a chat's bucket path gets a new folder each time another pod takes the chat. Every reader, meaning the browser, share links and the journal replica, must then find the newest folder and switch to it live. Each cold open also costs a bucket listing. - **What is built today:** two open changes, one for writers and one for readers, implement the folders as picked. That is option 3. - **What each option moves:** the bucket layout for pod chats and the readers of it. Macs keep their one path in every option. - **The two open changes:** option 1 closes the reader change and keeps only the code deletions from the writer change. Option 2 reworks both to the cheaper folder layout. Option 3 lands both as they are.
